# Basic Structure

#### Course: JavaScript in Browser

## Basic Structure

We start by laying out the basic HTML structure with some CSS, which includes:

1. Title: The title of the game.
2. Turn Info: Information to show whose turn it is.
3. Game Board: A grid made up of 9 clickable cells.

![Basic Structure](data:image/png;base64,)

Here's what the basic structure looks like:

```html
1<!-- Game Screen -->  
2<div id="gameScreen">
3    <div id="leftScreen">
4        <h1>Tic Tac Toe</h1>
5        <div id="turnInfo">Player 1's Turn</div>
6    </div>
7
8    <div id="rightScreen">
9        <div class="game-board" id="gameBoard">
10            <div class="cell" data-index="0"></div>
11            <div class="cell" data-index="1"></div>
12            <div class="cell" data-index="2"></div>
13            <div class="cell" data-index="3"></div>
14            <div class="cell" data-index="4"></div>
15            <div class="cell" data-index="5"></div>
16            <div class="cell" data-index="6"></div>
17            <div class="cell" data-index="7"></div>
18            <div class="cell" data-index="8"></div>
19        </div>
20    </div>
21</div>
```

```css
1* {
2    margin: 0;
3    padding: 0;
4    box-sizing: border-box;
5}
6
7body {
8    margin: 8px;
9    font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif;
10}
11
12h1 {
13    font-size: 40px;
14    color: #2A2A7B;
15    font-weight: bold;
16    margin: 20px;
17}
18
19div {
20    font-size: 24px;
21    color: #2A2A7B;
22    font-weight: bold;
23}
24
25/* Game Screen Styles */
26#gameScreen {
27    display: flex;
28    padding: 20px;
29    justify-content: space-around;
30}
31
32#turnInfo {
33    font-size: 28px;
34    font-weight: 500;
35    color: #6B6B9F;
36    margin-bottom: 40px;
37    text-align: center;
38}
39
40.game-board {
41    display: grid;
42    background: #40E7E7;
43    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
44    grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 100px);
45    grid-gap: 4px;
46    width: 320px;
47}
48
49.cell {
50    display: flex;
51    align-items: center;
52    justify-content: center;
53    background-color: white;
54    font-size: 36px;
55    font-weight: bold;
56    cursor: pointer;
57}
58
59.cell:hover {
60    background-color: #d5f7f7;
61}
```
